# Mike Verwer
The personal website of Mike Verwer, M. Sc. Mathematics.
This is the homepage. explore the site to learn more about me.

Information about YouTube videos made by Mike Verwer.
Contact me to request a video.
Explore my teaching history and the courses I teach.  You can also take a look at my teaching portfolio which contains my teaching philosophy and all of my credentials.
Take a look at the apps Mike has written. I've made a few programs that I use in my classes to showcase various concepts.
Mike Verwer graduated from McMaster University with a Masters degree in Mathematics in 2019 and ahs been teaching ever since.

This is an app I've written to demonstrate the Central Limit Theorem in statistics.  I use rolling dice as a an example and take the sum of the faces.
It is an interactive simulation that rolls `N` dice, `T` times and each roll is remembered and displayed.
This is an app I wrote to demonstrate the Seive of Eratosthenes.  It animates the algorithm, and the animation can be interacted with.
